message:
README: Fix NotFound FileSever part

Fixes #101
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index fa4973c..1a85fe5 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -303,7 +303,7 @@ You can use another [http.Handler](http://golang.org/pkg/net/http/#Handler), for
 The `NotFound` handler can for example be used to serve static files from the root path `/` (like an index.html file along with other assets):
 ```go
 // Serve static files from the ./public directory
-router.NotFound = http.FileServer(http.Dir("public")).ServeHTTP
+router.NotFound = http.FileServer(http.Dir("public"))
 ```
 
 But this approach sidesteps the strict core rules of this router to avoid routing problems. A cleaner approach is to use a distinct sub-path for serving files, like `/static/*filepath` or `/files/*filepath`.

explanation.what: README.md の "Static files" 節で、`http.FileServer(http.Dir("public")).ServeHTTP` という例を `http.FileServer(http.Dir("public"))` に修正した。http.FileServer は既に http.Handler を返すため、`.ServeHTTP` を router.NotFound(http.Handler 型)に直接代入すればよい。
explanation.why: コミットメッセージ "Fixes #101" の通り、ドキュメント中のサンプルコードの誤りを修正するため。

highlights.note: router.NotFound への代入例から冗長な .ServeHTTP を削除
